flags.why: Mất hồn phách here means being terrified, whereas losing one's soul suggests a spiritual loss.
flags.fix: He was scared out of his wits.

flags.why: Run rủi expresses fate or chance bringing something about, rather than an adjective describing something already arranged ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-run%20r%E1%BB%A7i)).
flags.fix: verb [literary] | to bring about through fate or chance

flags.why: Tỉnh thành does not have the adjective meaning 'developed; sophisticated' ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-t%E1%BB%89nh%20th%C3%A0nh)).
The meaning 'to scold' is regional to Bình Định and Phú Yên in Central Vietnam ([Wiktionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/k%C3%ACnh)).
